t: This is the statue of William Tyndale, a Grade II listed monument in Victoria Embankment Gardens. Tyndale was an English scholar and linguist, a leading figure in the Protestant Reformation, who translated much of the Bible into English before he was executed. The sculptor was Joseph Edgar Boehm, an Austrian-born artist who ran a large London studio and also made the Duke of Wellington statue at Hyde Park Corner. The design is by the architect Edward William Godwin, who moved from Gothic styles to the Anglo-Japanese taste of the Aesthetic movement.
